usedFor: Capsule CRM holds the contacts and opportunities, HubSpot receives them with “Create Deal” or “Update Contact”.

bestTemplate.name: “New or Updated Opportunity” in Capsule CRM, then “Create Deal” in HubSpot
bestTemplate.why: Each opportunity in Capsule CRM can open a matching deal in HubSpot.

watchOut: “New or Updated Opportunity” fires on updates too, so “Create Deal” can add a second deal for one opportunity.
